content:
Hello everyone,
My name is Serhat Emre Coban. I am a 4th year PhD student at EPFL. I have taken the course Formal Verification with Lean and AI last year and my interest in Lean started. For the last 5 months, I am developing "LeanInfoTheory" which is an information heory library in Lean build on top of mathlib. I wanted to formalize my paper "On Perfect Functitonal Representations" published in ISIT 2026 in Lean, however I noticed the lack of an info theory library in Lean that meets my needs and decided to develop it. Now, I finally did my first release on GitHub a few weeks ago. I am sure that it will be useful to other information theorists too, so feel free to check if you are interested in information theory. Here is the GitHub repo: https://github.com/serhatemrecoban/LeanInfoTheory. And, the project website: https://serhatemrecoban.github.io/LeanInfoTheory/. Now, I am formalizing my paper with LeanInfoTheory as a case study and keep developing LeanInfoTheory. I am using Codex for development, and reviewing the results both myself and with AI. I am still continuing to learn Lean and would be happy to meet with other community members especially with other information theorists.
Thank you.
Emre
